mapper.select: SELECT GRP_CD AS grpCd, CD_VAL AS cdVal, CD_NM AS cdNm, SORT_NO AS sortNo FROM CD_COMMON WHERE GRP_CD = #{grpCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CD_COMMON (GRP_CD, CD_VAL, CD_NM, SORT_NO, USE_YN, ATTR1, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{grpCd}, #{cdVal}, #{cdNm}, #{sortNo}, #{useYn}, #{attr1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM', SYSTIMESTAMP, 'SYSTEM')
